paragraphs: Rav Yitzḥak bar Rav Mesharshya, Eruvin (32, end of side b), Menaḥot (24, end of side b). He visited Rav Ashi's house, Ḥullin (104b). 'He is a great man,' Avodah Zarah (8b).
